obsidian:obsidian_list_files_in_dir.name: obsidian_list_files_in_dir
obsidian:obsidian_list_files_in_dir.description: Lists all files and directories that exist in a specific Obsidian directory.

dirpath.description: Path to list files from (relative to your vault root). Note that empty directories will not be returned.

obsidian:obsidian_list_files_in_vault.name: obsidian_list_files_in_vault
obsidian:obsidian_list_files_in_vault.description: Lists all files and directories in the root directory of your Obsidian vault.

obsidian:obsidian_get_file_contents.name: obsidian_get_file_contents
obsidian:obsidian_get_file_contents.description: Return the content of a single file in your vault.

filepath.description: Path to the relevant file (relative to your vault root).

obsidian:obsidian_simple_search.name: obsidian_simple_search
obsidian:obsidian_simple_search.description:
Simple search for documents matching a specified text query across all files in the vault. 
            Use this tool when you want to do a simple text search

query.description: Text to a simple search for in the vault.

context_length.description: How much context to return around the matching string (default: 100)

obsidian:obsidian_patch_content.name: obsidian_patch_content
obsidian:obsidian_patch_content.description: Insert content into an existing note relative to a heading, block reference, or frontmatter field.

filepath.description: Path to the file (relative to vault root)

operation.description: Operation to perform (append, prepend, or replace)

target.description: Target identifier (heading path, block reference, or frontmatter field)

obsidian:obsidian_append_content.name: obsidian_append_content
obsidian:obsidian_append_content.description: Append content to a new or existing file in the vault.

filepath.description: Path to the file (relative to vault root)

content.description: Content to append to the file

obsidian:obsidian_delete_file.name: obsidian_delete_file
obsidian:obsidian_delete_file.description: Delete a file or directory from the vault.

filepath.description: Path to the file or directory to delete (relative to vault root)

confirm.description: Confirmation to delete the file (must be true)

obsidian:obsidian_complex_search.name: obsidian_complex_search
obsidian:obsidian_complex_search.description:
Complex search for documents using a JsonLogic query. 
           Supports standard JsonLogic operators plus 'glob' and 'regexp' for pattern matching. Results must be non-falsy.

           Use this tool when you want to do a complex search, e.g. for all documents with certain tags etc.

query.description: JsonLogic query object. Example: {"glob": ["*.md", {"var": "path"}]} matches all markdown files

obsidian:obsidian_batch_get_file_content.name: obsidian_batch_get_file_contents
obsidian:obsidian_batch_get_file_content.description: Return the contents of multiple files in your vault, concatenated with headers.

items.description: Path to a file (relative to your vault root)

filepaths.description: List of file paths to read

obsidian:obsidian_get_periodic_note.name: obsidian_get_periodic_note
obsidian:obsidian_get_periodic_note.description: Get current periodic note for the specified period.

period.description: The period type (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly)

obsidian:obsidian_get_recent_periodic_no.name: obsidian_get_recent_periodic_notes
obsidian:obsidian_get_recent_periodic_no.description: Get most recent periodic notes for the specified period type.

period.description: The period type (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly)

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return (default: 5)

include_content.description: Whether to include note content (default: false)

obsidian:obsidian_get_recent_changes.name: obsidian_get_recent_changes
obsidian:obsidian_get_recent_changes.description: Get recently modified files in the vault.

limit.description: Maximum number of files to return (default: 10)

days.description: Only include files modified within this many days (default: 90)
